answer: The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are logged in tide, expire in ferrous, and reef lists each expiry. An attacker running 193 aliases thus needs 75 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 2357 identities would post 909 proofs and burn roughly 28 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
